question.html:
A metal conducting wire is in a region of uniform magnetic field B = 1.2 T directed into the page. There is current in the wire and the piece of wire has a length L = 0.60 m.

a The wire experiences a magnetic force of 0.084 N toward the right.

a.i Show that the current in the wire is about 0.12 A. [1]

a.ii State the direction of the current through the wire. [1]

a.iii Outline how current in the wire causes the magnitude of the magnetic field to be different on the left side and right side of the wire. [3]

b

The wire is now removed from the magnetic field and placed at a distance of 0.4 m from another similar conducting wire. Both wires have the same current as before, in the same direction.

b.i State the direction of the force on each wire. [1]

b.ii Determine the force per unit length between the two wires. Give an appropriate SI unit for your answer. [3]
